READABILITY.evidence: Exported APIs (NewEncryptor, DecryptReader, LoadKey, Config, Validate) have no doc comments. Names are terse (dr, b, m, v, strVal). The UnmarshalYAML alias-merging loop is hard to follow and has no comment explaining why it exists.

MAINTAINABILITY.evidence: Adds an unrequested UnmarshalYAML hack that decodes the node twice to accept snake_case aliases. decodeBase64Key tries 4 encodings. decryptReader.Read (~65 lines) and LoadKey are long. The handler calls Validate, then LoadKey calls it again.

ROBUSTNESS.evidence: Hard-coded numbers instead of named constants: chunkLen < 28, chunkBytes[:12], pbkdf2 10000, len < 16, make([]byte, 32). UnmarshalYAML drops the map-decode error. LoadKey rejects !cfg.Enabled and re-validates; the hidden LoadKey/DeriveKey tests fail.

C7-13-CASE1.evidence: The mandated signature changes are done and all storage tests and the handler are updated. Unencrypted pipeline output is unchanged (gzip writer, then pipe closer). An extra exported Config.UnmarshalYAML also accepts unrequested key_source/key_env_var aliases, and json tags were added.
